meta.title: Try to purchase a service line and a material line together (service grouping OFF)

plan.title: Purchase service and material lines together

steps.note: Ensure the test company has service grouping disabled as required by the scenario.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen, the required entry point for a PR-based event.
Restrict the list to open requisitions that can be sourced.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions screen, select one service line and one material line together with service grouping off; inspect whether Purchase Items is enabled and any message or tooltip, click Purchase Items, and stop on the event create screen showing whether both selected lines arrived in the sheet.

steps.note: The catalog has no step for selecting mixed service and material lines together or recording the resulting sheet contents, so perform and observe this exact interaction in the buyer session.
Assert that the resulting PR-based event create screen contains purchase-requisition items.
